title: What If You Were Born on Mars in 2100?

avatar.name: pip
avatar.design: small knitted-wool doll figure in cream wool with visible stitch texture, oversized glossy green enamel button eyes, sunflower-yellow pom-pom beanie

spec.silhouette: compact rounded figure: big round head under a sunflower-yellow pom-pom beanie, soft pear-shaped body, short stubby limbs; reads instantly at thumbnail size
spec.proportions: head 1/3 of height as newborn, 1/4 as child, 1/5 as teen and adult; button eyes about 1/3 of face width
spec.materials: cream knitted wool with visible stitch rows, slightly fuzzy edges, glossy green enamel buttons for eyes, small stitched curved mouth in brown thread
spec.clothing: permanent accent: sunflower-yellow knitted pom-pom beanie (never in any background); per-chapter garments in stage_changes
identifying_features: one darker cream darning patch on the left cheek

stage_changes.clothing: cut-down orange colony jumpsuit; outdoors a small orange pressure suit with a polycarbonate bubble helmet
patched grey utility coveralls, dust goggles pushed up on the beanie
stage_changes.state: red dust worked into the wool edges

stage_changes.clothing: navy travel jacket with a plain round mission patch, shoulder bag
green greenhouse apron over coveralls, soil-stained hands
stage_changes.state: beanie faded, a few repair stitches in yellow thread, settled and calm

signature_prop: dented tin cup holding an apple seed sent from Earth (seed -> sapling -> tree -> new seed)

lines.what: avatar stage frames (edits of the approved reference)

cost_preflight.approved_note: User approved 2026-10-02; scope: avatar reference only for now

notes: Timings are pre-narration estimates; Phase 5 retimes them to Whisper word timestamps.
dur = final edited hold; gen_duration = Seedance source clip (>=4s), trimmed to useful_window.
Hook contains 'year 2100' inside the question; the validator treats it as premise, not a chapter stamp.

shots.line: What would happen if you were born on Mars in the year 2100?
shots.environment: buried habitat nursery, curved regolith-brick walls, small porthole showing red dust blowing outside, warm amber lamps
shots.action: newborn avatar in a padded incubator pod opens its button eyes as red dust streaks past the porthole

shots.line: Day one. You're born under three metres of dirt that blocks radiation.
shots.environment: cutaway of habitat dome buried under red regolith mounds, warm interior light, rocky crater outside
shots.action: a parent in a grey colony jumpsuit lifts the swaddled newborn as soil trickles on the dome roof

shots.line: Your first cry, sent by radio, takes twelve minutes to reach Earth.
shots.keyframe_reason: diegetic UI: signal-delay counter '12:00' on comms screen
shots.environment: comms alcove, glowing screen with a transmission bar and delay counter reading 12:00
shots.action: the newborn wails in the foreground while a signal bar crawls across the screen behind

shots.line: Your parents carried one gift from Earth: an apple seed in a tin cup.
shots.environment: habitat nursery shelf, warm lamp
shots.action: tiny wool hand reaches and touches a dented tin cup holding one apple seed in dark soil

shots.line: Year six. You weigh just over a third of an Earth kid.
shots.environment: underground school tunnel, padded walls, painted planet murals, cool white strip lights
shots.action: six-year-old avatar steps onto a floor scale whose needle barely moves; classmates giggle behind

shots.line: Every jump in the school tunnel becomes a slow, floating flight.
shots.environment: same school tunnel
shots.action: the child leaps and floats in a long slow arc over a line of laughing classmates

shots.line: Outside, without a suit, you'd pass out in seconds as your saliva boils.
shots.environment: airlock chamber, red warning light, pressure gauge
shots.action: the child in a small orange pressure suit seals a bubble helmet as the airlock light turns from red to green

shots.line: The noon sky is butterscotch. The sunsets glow blue.
shots.keyframe_reason: composition: tiny suited child silhouetted against a blue Martian sunset
shots.environment: crater rim at dusk, cold blue glow around a small pale sun, butterscotch sky above, long shadows
shots.action: the suited child stands on the crater rim as the sun sinks and the blue halo spreads

shots.line: Year fourteen. A dust storm swallows the whole planet for months.
shots.keyframe_reason: chapter 3 opener: planet-wide dust storm wall
shots.environment: habitat observation window, a towering brown dust wall rolling across the plain, light dimming to rust
shots.action: the teen avatar presses a hand to the window as the dust wall swallows the horizon

shots.line: The solar panels go dark. The colony rations every watt.
shots.environment: habitat corridor under red emergency lighting, dust-caked solar panels visible through a porthole
shots.action: the teen switches off lamps one by one as the corridor drops into red emergency light

shots.line: You dig the greenhouse out by hand, sol after sol.
shots.environment: outside the greenhouse dome in swirling brown dust, half-buried dome
shots.action: the teen in a dusty pressure suit shovels drifts away from the greenhouse door

shots.line: Your seed is now a sapling, the only green for kilometres.
shots.environment: greenhouse bench under dim red grow-light
shots.action: hard colour flip: after the rust-red storm, a vivid green apple sapling glows under the grow-light in the tin cup as the teen's gloved hand cups it

shots.line: Year twenty-two. You finally win a seat on the ship to Earth.
shots.keyframe_reason: chapter 4 opener: launch hall with ship on the pad
shots.environment: launch hall with a tall window, a silver passenger rocket on the pad outside, pale morning light
shots.action: the adult avatar raises a glowing boarding token and grins at the rocket outside

shots.line: Launch windows open every twenty-six months. You've waited years.
shots.environment: launch hall crowd with luggage, departure board glowing, rocket through the window
shots.action: colonists stream toward a boarding gate while the avatar waits in line clutching a bag

shots.line: Then the medical scan flashes red.
shots.keyframe_reason: diegetic UI: medical scanner panel flashing red 'NOT CLEARED'
shots.environment: medical scan booth, scanner arch, red alert panel
shots.action: the avatar stands in the scanner arch as the panel flashes red and its smile fades

shots.line: You grew up in Mars gravity. On Earth, you'd feel nearly three times heavier.
shots.environment: clinic room with a gravity-simulator harness
shots.action: in a gravity simulator, the avatar's knees buckle and it grips the handrails, straining

shots.line: The ship leaves without you.
shots.environment: the same launch hall window, rocket lifting off on a pillar of flame
shots.action: the avatar presses a palm to the window as the rocket rises and the hall trembles
shots.audio_note: muffled rocket rumble and window tremble sells the departure; no speech, no music

shots.line: Year thirty. You run the largest garden on Mars.
shots.environment: huge greenhouse dome, terraced green rows, misting sprinklers, red cliffs beyond the dome
shots.action: the adult avatar walks a row of crops with a watering can, mist drifting in shafts of light

shots.line: The seed from Earth is now a tree taller than you.
shots.environment: the same greenhouse, a young apple tree at its centre
shots.action: the avatar reaches up and picks a red apple from the tree

shots.line: Then a baby is born in the nursery where you were born.
shots.environment: the same nursery and incubator pod from the hook, warm amber lamps
shots.action: the avatar leans over the incubator as a newborn's hand grips its wool finger

shots.line: You plant a new seed in a tin cup.
shots.environment: nursery shelf beside the incubator
shots.action: the avatar's hands press an apple seed into soil in a fresh tin cup

shots.line: You were never an Earthling on Mars. You're the first Martian.
shots.keyframe_reason: payoff frame: prop callback in final tableau (xhigh)
shots.environment: greenhouse dome at blue sunset, apple tree behind, red plains and the blue-haloed sun beyond
shots.action: the avatar looks up at a tiny blue dot (Earth) in the dusk sky, then lifts the tin cup with the new seed toward it, the apple tree glowing behind
